train_decision_tree_classifier: train a DecisionTreeClassifier on the iris dataset with max_leaf_nodes=3 and random_state=0
analyze_tree_structure: analyze the binary tree structure by traversing nodes to compute depth and identify leaf nodes
get_decision_path: get the decision path of a sample using decision_path to retrieve nodes traversed by the sample
get_leaf_prediction: get the leaf node reached by a sample using apply and print the splitting rules used for prediction
find_common_nodes: find common decision nodes shared by a group of samples using the decision_path indicator matrix
